en-US.title: Ticketiv Organizer
en-US.shortDescription: Ticket scanning and check-in for Ticketiv event teams.
en-US.fullDescription:
Ticketiv Organizer is the app for teams running events on Ticketiv. It replaces Ticketiv Access: if you used Access, you already have it. Attendees should use the Ticketiv app to discover events and access their tickets.

Pair your device with a setup code from your event organizer and select your assigned event. Use the camera to scan ticket QR codes and see the validation result, duplicate-entry warnings and check-in totals for your device.

Prepare your event manifest while connected before working offline. Offline scans are stored on the device and synchronized when connectivity returns. Keep devices synchronized during an event so your team works with current check-in information.

An event assignment from an organizer is required. Camera permission is used for QR scanning. Contact your event organizer for access or support@ticketiv.app for assistance.
